summary.intent: Work through the v1 hardening plan for the callisto release tool: land the planned workstreams (cleanup, test debt, SYS-RETRY, SYS-NAPI, refactors, T06 canonical ids, deps) as independent or stacked PRs, keep them mergeable, and continue with bug fixes and gaps.
summary.outcome: Opened and, with the user's merges, landed many PRs (#202-#208, #274-#288 etc.) with local just ci green each. Migrated schemars to 1.x, restacked conflicting PRs, and opened new PRs for the A2 HEAD-binding fix, E176 operation display, and a 24-crate dependency update (committed on a new branch, PR not yet confirmed opened).

repo: Tracking/handoff plans must stay local: NEXT-WORK.md lives at .claude/plans/ and is excluded via .git/info/exclude, never committed or put in a PR.
Local gate is `just ci`; judge it by the script log's own `exit=` line, not the background task wrapper's exit code (the wrapper reported 0 when the log showed exit=1/100/101).
docs/errors.md has a total-codes count that every PR adding an E-code bumps, so such PRs conflict with each other and need rebases after each merge.
Native stacks are made with `gh stack link`; PRs touching the same files (status.rs; version.rs/identity.rs/digest.rs/execution.rs) should be stacked, e.g. #279/#280 and #281->#286->#283.

Rerun-after-failed-push fix: a package whose current version is tagged on HEAD now has all operations (registry, tag, GitHub release) observed; a tag on an older commit settles without contacting providers.
schemars 1.x emits draft 2020-12: `$defs` instead of `definitions`, `const` instead of one-element enum, and types read through try_from need JsonSchema on the wire type.
Dependency bumps needed code fixes: sha2 0.11 lacks `{:x}` digest formatting, comfy-table 8 replaced load_preset, and toml 1.x `str::parse::<Value>()` parses a single value, not a document.
Generated workflow template jq must not use `mapfile` (macOS bash lacks it) and intent omits empty artifactSlots so `.artifactSlots[]` iterates null.

Quality conventions: commits are GPG-signed, no session links in commits/PRs per AGENTS.md, changesets added for user-visible changes, and tests are proven by mutation or by failing first on old code.

code.finding: Release derive function was split into stage functions after snapshot characterization tests; uploads_by_package moved into OpIndex to satisfy clippy complex-type.
Tag observation read annotation text and rejected multi-paragraph/signed tags; it now reads only the object type, as the spec says annotation text is never compared.

workflow: Write the failing reproduction (or characterization snapshots plus mutation checks) before the fix, and prefer real tools over fakes since fakes hid earlier bugs.
Check pairwise merge conflicts across open branches before opening a batch of PRs; stack those that truly overlap.

The sandbox blocks inline env, heredocs, scripts mentioning git, cargo registry writes, network/gh TLS, and GPG signing; workaround was script files, Edit tool, or running those steps outside the sandbox.
Edits are only allowed inside the current worktree, so switch worktrees with ExitWorktree/EnterWorktree rather than cd.
A plain `git push` can silently do nothing when the local branch name differs from the remote's; push explicitly.

friction: Wrongly put the local-only plan in PR #201, which the user had to point out and which was closed.
Opened a batch of parallel PRs off main without checking for overlap, causing seven conflicting pairs and a failing #281 after merges.
Sandbox restrictions repeatedly blocked commands (heredocs, env, signing, cargo fetch, gh TLS), forcing workarounds.
Background-task notifications reported exit 0 while CI had actually failed, requiring log inspection.
Pre-commit hook rejected formatting and fmt-check failed in CI runs, causing reruns.
Hosted Ubuntu CI failed on tests that passed locally on macOS (bare package names in a verdaccio test).
Dependabot #275 was red due to a major bump needing code migration.
open_items: Open the PR for the 24-crate dependency update (committed on a new branch, not Dependabot's) and confirm hosted CI.
Branch cleanup (docs/next-work-plan, docs/spec-rewrite, fix/native-resolution and ~35 local branches) awaits per-branch user approval.
W1 real-service credential check needs a decision on where it runs in CI.
Remaining T08-RETRY references in roadmap, plan JSON and guide need a follow-up edit.
A5 registry-repository check, floating v1 action tag, Intel-mac and aarch64-linux binaries, T08 selection, and T12 with scratch-registry credentials remain.
Fuzz targets are only compile-checked, and E176 was never reproduced against a real registry.
Unverified real gh/cargo/registry reads for SYS-RETRY; OIDC trusted publishing is post-1.0.
User actions pending: accept ADR 12 and cut 0.12.0 (#248).
D01-blocked work (SYS-MATURIN, W9) and W10 decisions are unresolved; W11 needs credentials and an approved run.
